The year '''1066 BBY before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (BBY)''' was a span of [[Time/Legends|time]] that occurred during the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Events==
*[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Vilia Calimondra]] instigates the ''[[Charge Matrica]]'', a contest between [[Gender/Legends|her]] seven children, to determine which one would become her heir.<ref name="ChargeMatricaStartYear">Page 302 of the novel [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] mentions that the ''Charge Matrica'' began 34 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of the book. As the [[StarWars.com]] article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that ''Knight Errant'' is set in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], this places the start of the contest in 1066 BBY.</ref>
